question: the ligament field under the inclusion's own multiaxial strain (00_07 HW.23, ceiling (4) of 01_01 §5.2)

rules.binding: lowest peak over rungs × measures → highest threshold over the alloy's cells (and θ if free); up0

verdict: Under the inclusion's own multiaxial strain (106's Eshelby ε_I per cell, the material-tensor form of each rung, 105's three angles), on the empty-pore fill — the one where the strain and the field are one body — the ligament peak on a large stem at SF 2 (p99) binds above a surface strain of 930 µε for Ti-6Al-4V with the install angle free (rh95|stiff|pores_carry_nothing|th45|s24, t_L 0.779; the off-L components change the peak ×1.01 to ×1.01 over the share's part there, over the fill's cells ×0.98 to ×2.35) and at θ = 0 above 565 µε, where the cube takes more than the wood (t_L > 1); 105's uniaxial reading at t_L = 1 gives 731 µε with the angle free and 551 µε at θ = 0. On the filled fills, whose field is not their own (direction of the error not bounded), the figure reads 1158 µε (additive) and 1361 µε (Voigt bound). The source day on a large stem at SF 2 against the empty-pore threshold: the median (918 µε) reaches it for CP-Ti-Gr4, Ta at p99 and Ti-6Al-4V, Ti-6Al-7Nb, CP-Ti-Gr4, beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr, Ta, Ti-15Zr at p99.9; the upper whisker (1837 µε) for Ti-6Al-4V, Ti-6Al-7Nb, CP-Ti-Gr4, beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr, Ta, Ti-15Zr at p99 and Ti-6Al-4V, Ti-6Al-7Nb, CP-Ti-Gr4, beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr, Ta, Ti-15Zr at p99.9.
